diagram_previews.alt: Oblique view of the unit cube with the tetrahedron OABC inside it: O at the front lower left, A(1,0,0) to the right, B at the back and C(0,0,1) at the top; its face ABC is shaded blue and hidden edges are dashed. A red triangle is the cross-section of the tetrahedron at height h, marked on the edge OC.
